Opening the DealBook transcript and the decoder xAI article.I found one prediction from 2023 that fits all four rules, and I only have it from a newsletter's reprint, not from a transcript. A second claim, AGI by 2029, I only saw as a reporter's summary, never in Musk's own words. I flag both below.

1. **DealBook Summit, 29 November 2023.** I opened Rev's transcript of this interview, but the page only gave me the first few minutes, so the AI exchange never came through. The wording I quote comes from a 2024 Substack newsletter (thoughtleader.school), which dates the interview 29 November 2023 and reprints Musk saying: "I would say we are less than three years from that point." The "point" is AI that could write a novel as good as JK Rowling's, discover new physics or invent new technology. One problem: a search snippet of the Rev transcript, which I can't quote from, gave slightly different wording, with the line at about 53 minutes. So the exact words should be checked against Rev or the DealBook video before this is relied on.

2. **xAI launch on Twitter Spaces, 14 July 2023.** The Decoder article I opened only paraphrases Musk: "Musk believes it is realistic to expect such AGI to exist by 2029." Other search snippets say he agreed with Ray Kurzweil's 2029 date, "give or take a year", but I never opened a page with his own words. I've put it in the list for you to judge, marked coverage_only and empty of his words. The recording is at twitter.com/xai/status/1679945247340793856.

**Left out:**
- In the July 2023 Tesla earnings call, Musk forecast in-house neural-net training capacity of "100 exo FLOPs by the end of next year". That's a computing-capacity forecast, so it stays out. The transcript page cut off before the Q&A, so I couldn't check whether he gave a year for self-driving.
- The free part of the Rishi Sunak conversation (2 November 2023) gives no date for AI passing human intelligence. The rest is behind a paywall.
